concept: A row of quiet tools over the Input groove for short formatted text, each tool saying whether its mark is on.

default_to_avoid.pattern: a rich text editor with a full word processor ribbon of fonts, colours and sizes
default_to_avoid.kind: rich text editor, WYSIWYG, text editor
default_to_avoid.why_not: a ribbon of fonts and colours lets text leave the system type and hues; Pane offers the few marks that matter

derivation.consequence: secondary text keeps the lowest opacity that still measured as passing; text halos count only where WCAG allows them
derivation.form: the text stays in the system type, and pasted text arrives plain so it takes the field type

derivation.consequence: selected and pressed states change shape or add a mark (a check, a ring), never only colour
derivation.form: a mark that is on takes chosen glass and aria-pressed, so state reads by more than tone

derivation.consequence: light falls from above, so every surface carries a rim brightest along its top edge and a soft shadow below that says where it floats, and a recess is the inverse, shaded under its top lip and lit on its bottom lip; a nested surface adds no second blur, because one sheet of glass is one layer
derivation.form: the text sits in the Input groove like every field

options: A few tools over the groove
variants.picked: A few tools over the groove
variants.reason: A keeps the system type (P2) and the field family (P3). B lets text leave the system. C asks readers to learn syntax.

root.why: the toolbar and the field stack with a small gap

toolbar.why: the toolbar is one tab stop with arrow keys between its tools

tool.why: each tool is a 44px square button so it can be pressed by touch

on.why: a mark that is on takes chosen glass

glyph.why: each tool glyph is drawn with the ring stroke

box.why: the text sits in the Input groove at body size

disabled.why: a disabled editor dims its text and refuses edits

@media forced-colors: active.why: in forced colours the system draws the edges and marks so every part stays findable

hover.why: a tool takes the quiet surface under the pointer

focus-visible.why: the focus ring shows when the part is reached by keyboard

data-placeholder.why: an empty editor shows its placeholder in the secondary tone

disabled.why: a disabled tool keeps no hover so it does not invite a press

aria-readonly=true.why: a read-only value drops the groove for a hairline, so it reads as settled but can still be focused and copied

aria-invalid=true.why: a wrong answer takes the critical ring a field takes, and FormField says what is wrong in words

background-color.why: the tool surface fades in on the hover ease
